body: Wire server/worldcrisis.Crisis into apps2/mud. Crisis auto-starts on first login. 1Hz loop ticks phases and broadcasts banners. crisis command shows phase/LEY/objectives. NM kills (nm-* prefix) → ObjectiveIntercept +10 LEY. Successful mine → ObjectiveRitual +5 LEY. crisis-ley <n> GMcommand.
title: S95-01: MUD World Crisis — server/worldcrisis wired, crisis command, phase broadcast, objective contributions
